sam (prod-mgr): Heads-up — BrightBank asked us to onboard fermi-40B and wants a private deployment. They care about <2s p95 for 512 tokens, and prefer a 4-bit quantized variant. Can we do an ETA and quick triage?

maria (eng-ml): assigning to eng-ml. Couple quick checks: do we have HF weights or a private artifact? and any legal export/KMS constraints?

cheng (eng-ml): I can lead bring-up. Need HF link or model tarball + sample prompts and an eval set. Plan: FP16 smoke -> PTQ 4-bit (GPTQ-style) -> perf/quality sweep.

sam (prod-mgr): Eva from solutions will supply prompts and the eval set. They also mentioned on-prem requirement (customer-managed VPC) and KMS for keys.

cheng (eng-ml): ok. rough timeline: smoke + compile kernel selection 1-2 days, PTQ & perf sweep 2-3 days, regression/eval + docs 1-2 days. Can probably deliver an initial quantized candidate in ~1 week if nothing blocks.

maria (eng-ml): resource-wise: reserve one dev-GPU node (a40/80GB) for model compile + a CPU job for PTQ. @infra: pls reserve. Also need to add model to model-catalog with a variant tag (fermi-40B/4bit).

eva (solutions): Customer will upload eval set via S3 link by EOD tomorrow. Compliance: they need HSM-backed KMS. I'll loop in security.

cheng (eng-ml): quick smoke commands I'll run:
```
# run local smoke and eval harness
python infra/eval/run.py --model /mnt/models/fermi-40b/fp16 --prompts samples/brightbank_prompts.jsonl --max_tokens 512 --batch 2
# perf microbench
python infra/bench/latency.py --model /mnt/models/fermi-40b/4bit --iters 100 --seq 512
```

maria (eng-ml): checklist for onboarding (first pass):
- model artifact available (hf/s3)
- smoke FP16 run successful
- quantization recipe & baseline quality metrics
- perf target met (p95 < 2s @512) on target hardware
- model-catalog entry + versioning + manifest
- security/compliance (KMS, VPC) signoff
- rollout plan + canary policy

sam (prod-mgr): priority = high (customer paid PoC). SLA required: 99.9% uptime for private infra during trial. Sam to coordinate contract.

deploy-bot: model-upload job #7845 started for fermi-40b artifact (waiting for checksum). :package:

cheng (eng-ml): blockers to flag early:
- missing eval set (blocks reg checks)
- KMS/HSM availability in customer VPC (blocks private deployment)
- unsupported ops that force fallback to FP16 in runtime (perf risk)

eva (solutions): I'll confirm eval S3 link + KMS details by tomorrow morning.

maria (eng-ml): leaving notes: if PTQ degrades quality > 3% on key metrics, we'll try SMT quant-aware finetune (needs cust data & eval signoff).

sam (prod-mgr): great. Changelog this thread into the intake tracker (board) and assign eng owner = cheng, PM owner = sam. I'll follow up with procurement/security. :thumbsup:
